format: government/defense (USAJobs style): Duties / Conditions of Employment / Qualifications / Desired Qualifications / Equal Employment Opportunity, clearance text
note: 'Conditions of Employment' is an unknown heading, but 'Must have FEA experience' is a modal-prefix cue, so FEA is required and its evidence is that line (earliest in the required tier). 'Must be able to obtain ... clearance' and 'Must be able to lift' bind nothing (R2.8.10; no skills there anyway). 'technical reports ... as required' must not bind (Technical Writing unscored). 'Knowledge of PLC programming is not required' is negation_after: PLC is in no group. 'Equal Employment Opportunity' is excluded vocabulary (no skills). Resume: MATLAB really negated; MBSE hypothetical; 'with no failed shock' and 'zero field cracks' are not negations.
posting_text:
Mechanical Engineer (Structures), GS-0830-12
Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division
Open to U.S. citizens only. Security clearance required.

Duties
- Performs structural analysis and fatigue analysis of shipboard machinery foundations
- Prepares technical reports and engineering change proposals as required
- Reviews contractor drawings for compliance with ASME Y14.5 and MIL-STD-2035

Conditions of Employment
- Must be a U.S. citizen
- Must be able to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance
- Must have FEA experience with shell and solid element models
- Must be able to lift 40 pounds and climb ladders aboard ship

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from an ABET-accredited program
- One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-11, including finite element analysis with ANSYS or a similar tool
- Experience with MATLAB for post-processing test data

Desired Qualifications
- Registration as a Professional Engineer or passing the Fundamentals of Engineering exam
- Experience with model-based systems engineering
- Experience with CATIA V5
- Knowledge of PLC programming is not required

Equal Employment Opportunity

The Department of the Navy is an equal opportunity employer. Selection for this position will be made without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, or political affiliation. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants with disabilities.
